info.text:
# Grand Theft Auto V

## Where is the options page?

The [player options page for this game](../player-options) contains all the options you need to configure and
export a config file.

## What does randomization do to this game?

GTA V story mode becomes a sterile open world: the story never moves forward on its own and you start with a single
character, no money and no weapons. Missions are played through the game's own replay system, from markers that only
appear once you have the mission's item and a character who can start it. The 247 hidden collectibles (spaceship
parts, letter scraps, nuclear waste, submarine parts, monkey mosaics, peyote plants, Epsilon tracts) are all
available from the start as floating objects, and the free roam is full of checks: stunt jumps, flights under the
bridges, knife flights, 44 landmarks to visit (purple markers on the map), skill levels and police escapes.

## What items and locations get shuffled?

Items: the three characters (one is given at the start), one unlock per mission, money, Weapon Gifts (a random weapon,
online weapons included), Vehicle Gifts (a random vehicle from a list: Deluxo, Oppressor Mk II, Stromberg, helicopters,
a submarine...), the Collectible Radar (the route to the nearest collectible), the three special abilities (an option
can give them from the start), six guaranteed vehicles (a sports car, a
motorcycle, a helicopter, an underwater vehicle, a boat and the Scramjet) and 53 traps. The helicopter and the
underwater vehicle are placed early; the underwater collectibles need the underwater vehicle in logic.

A mission is in logic when you have its item, a character who can start it, and every character it is played with
(a heist with Michael, Franklin and Trevor needs the three of them).

Locations: the replayable story missions (67; the free-roam preparations are left out because they break as replays) and Strangers and Freaks missions (44, optional), cut down to the
Mission Count you choose, bonus checks per mission, "Gold Medal N" and "Objective N" counters, and collectible
milestones ("Spaceship Parts: at 5 collected": a count of pickups, whichever ones), each worth up to three locations,
the same milestones for stunt jumps, bridges and knife flights ("Stunt Jumps: 5 completed"), one location per
landmark ("Visit Mount Chiliad Summit"), skill levels ("Trevor: Flying 60%") and police escapes. The high milestones
are paced by your mission progress in logic; the bridges and knife flights need the Helicopter, a character's skills
need that character.

## Which items can be in another player's world?

All of them, including the characters and the mission unlocks.

## What does another world's item look like in GTA V?

Nothing physical: when you pass a mission or pick up a collectible, a notification tells you what you sent and to
whom.

## When the player receives an item, what happens?

A phone-style message, with the slot that sent the item as its contact, shows the item, and the item takes effect: a
new mission marker, a character in the wheel, money, a weapon in your hands, a vehicle in your garage (F6 > Vehicles)
or a boat to call on the water (F6 > Boats). During a mission, weapons are given at once. Traps are only
announced as "a trap" so they stay a surprise; F6 > Recent traps lists them precisely afterwards. Everything stays
in F6 > Archipelago log, with the full list of received items and every check of the multiworld.

## What is the goal?

Depending on the options:

- **finale**: pass one of the three final missions.
- **the_third_way**: pass The Third Way.
- **mission_percentage**: pass a share of the missions of your world, any of them.
- **one_mission**: pass the mission you pick in Goal Mission (a drop-down list), or a surprise one that needs a
  character you do not start with.
- **one_collectible**: pick up one random collectible; the client tells you which one and can route you to it.
- **one_check**: check one random location of your world; the client tells you which one.
- **check_percentage**: check a share of all the locations of your world.
- **free_roam**: check a number of free-roam locations (landmarks, stunt jumps, bridges, skills...).

The final missions do not open right away: you need to pass a share of the other missions of your world first (Finale
Unlock Percentage, 60 % by default), plus the 6 heists (not their preparations), like in the story. With the
finale and the_third_way goals, the heists are always in your world. The same share applies to the Goal Mission of the
one_mission goal. F6 > Progress > Goal lists every step, mission by mission, with Done / To do.

When the goal is done, the room's release setting decides whether your remaining items are sent to the others.

With Post-Goal Chaos on, the game goes on after the goal: passed missions come back on the map at random and the
other players' checks can set off traps and gifts in your game.

## How long is a game?

The spoiler log and F6 > Progress show two estimates: the time to reach the goal (the missions it needs, plus 30 %
for unlocks and driving) and an upper bound for every location. Count about 10 minutes per story mission (20 for a
heist and the big finales), 6 per Strangers and Freaks mission, 2 per collectible, 3 per stunt jump, landmark or
police escape, and 1 per skill level. With the default options, the free-roam checks add about 11 hours to the upper
bound:

| Settings | To the goal | Every location (upper bound) |
|---|---|---|
| Default (finale, 30 missions, every collectible and free-roam check) | about 4 hours | about 26 hours |
| "Short" preset (20 missions, spaceship parts, a few free-roam checks) | about 3 hours | about 11 hours |
| "Ten Hours" preset (finale, 80 missions) | about 10 hours | about 33 hours |
| "One Mission" preset (50 missions) | about 4 h 30 | about 26 hours |
| "Free Roam" preset (20 missions, goal: 120 free-roam checks) | about 4 hours | about 22 hours |
| "Everything" preset (111 missions, every check) | about 14 hours | about 45 hours |

Presets: on the website's player options page, pick one in the "Preset" list at the top. In the Archipelago
launcher, "Generate Template Options" writes one YAML per preset in `Players/Templates/Presets` (the Options Creator
does not show presets). They are also in the `presets` folder of the GameArchipelago repository.

To keep a game around an evening, lower Mission Count, set the collectibles you do not want to 0 and use the
"one_mission" goal. With a release at the goal, you do not need to do everything.

## Is it safe with GTA Online?

The mods need BattlEye turned off, and GTA Online cannot be played with BattlEye off. The client also closes the game
if an online session starts while the mods are loaded. Use the setup's "Disable mods" button and turn BattlEye back on
before playing GTA Online. The ScriptHookVDotNet console (F4) and the Native Trainer are turned off by the setup.

tutorials.text:
# GTA V Archipelago Setup Guide

## Required software

- GTA V **Legacy** 1.0.3889 (the latest version) or 1.0.3725 (Steam, Epic or Rockstar Games Launcher). GTA V Enhanced is not supported.
- [ScriptHookV](http://www.dev-c.com/gtav/scripthookv/) for your game version.
- The GTA V Archipelago Setup (`GTAVArchipelagoSetup.exe`), from the GTAVArchipelagoSetup releases.
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.4 or newer to generate games.

## Installation

1. Run `GTAVArchipelagoSetup.exe`. It finds your GTA V folder (or use Browse).
2. Click **Install / Update**. It installs ScriptHookVDotNet, LemonUI and the five mods in a new `Archipelago` folder
   next to `GTA5.exe`, and sets `ScriptsLocation="Archipelago"` in `ScriptHookVDotNet.ini`.
3. If ScriptHookV is missing, download its zip from dev-c.com, click **ScriptHookV...** and select the zip.
4. Turn BattlEye off:
   - Rockstar Games Launcher: Settings > Grand Theft Auto V Legacy > uncheck *Enable BattlEye*.
   - Steam: GTA V Legacy > Properties > Launch Options: `-nobattleye`.
   - Epic Games: Library > GTA V > Manage > Launch Options: `-nobattleye`.

## Generating a game

1. Install `gtav.apworld`: the setup copies it to the `custom_worlds` folder of your Archipelago installation when it
   finds it; otherwise double-click the file.
2. Create your options file from the player options page, or with "Generate Template Options" in the Archipelago
   launcher, and generate as usual.

## Connecting

1. Start GTA V and load any save.
2. Press **F6** > Connection, enter the server address (for example `archipelago.gg:38281`), your slot name and the
   password if there is one, then **Connect**.
3. Start a **New Game** from the pause menu. GameEnvironment creates the Archipelago world with your slot's starting
   character. Save it in a free slot.

The client remembers the connection and reconnects by itself next time.

## Streaming

Turn on **F6 > Settings > Stream safe** (or remove `Irresistible` from `enabled_traps`): one trap uses strip club
dancer models that can show nudity.

readme.text:
# GTA V Archipelago

Play **Grand Theft Auto V** story mode in an [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) multiworld randomizer.

Los Santos starts empty: no story, one character, no money. Missions, Strangers and Freaks, gold medals, optional
objectives, 247 hidden collectibles, stunt jumps, bridges, landmarks, skills and police escapes are checks. Michael, Franklin and Trevor, the mission unlocks, money, weapons,
fun vehicles and more than fifty traps are items, shuffled with the other games of the multiworld.

**[Download the latest release](https://github.com/dudleydehenau/GTAV-Archipelago/releases/latest)**: grab
`GTAVArchipelagoSetup`, it installs everything else for you.

> [!NOTE]
> This is version 1.2. It can be played from start to finish, but expect some rough edges. More randomized
> content and more options are in development. Feedback is very welcome, see
> [Feedback and bug reports](#feedback-and-bug-reports).

> [!CAUTION]
> Story mode only, with BattlEye turned off. Before playing GTA Online, click **GTA Online mode** in the
> setup and turn BattlEye back on.

> [!WARNING]
> **Streamers:** one trap can show nudity. Turn on **F6 > Settings > Stream safe** in game, or use the "Stream Safe"
> preset.

The full guide (quick start, options, in-game menu, how checks work) is in
[GameArchipelago/README.md](GameArchipelago/README.md).

## Requirements

- GTA V **Legacy** 1.0.3889 (the latest version) or 1.0.3725 (Steam, Epic or Rockstar Games Launcher). The game
  version is detected at startup. The Enhanced edition is not supported.
- [ScriptHookV](http://www.dev-c.com/gtav/scripthookv/) (the setup installs it from the zip you download there).
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases) 0.6.4 or newer to generate a game.

## Setup

1. Download `GTAVArchipelagoSetup` from the [latest release](https://github.com/dudleydehenau/GTAV-Archipelago/releases/latest)
   and run it. It installs ScriptHookVDotNet, LemonUI, the mods and the APWorld.
2. Install ScriptHookV with step 2 of the setup: open the download page, download the zip made for your game
   version, and the setup finds it in your Downloads folder (you can also drag the zip onto the window).
3. Turn BattlEye off: in the Rockstar Games Launcher settings, or with `-nobattleye` in the Steam or Epic launch
   options.
4. Generate your game with `gtav.apworld`. Presets are included: Short, Ten Hours, One Mission, Everything,
   Stream Safe.
5. Start GTA V, press **F6**, open **Connection**, enter the room address, your slot name and password, then start a
   **New Game** from the pause menu.

## Known issues

- The mods never save the game, and any save the game writes by itself is deleted: every start is a new game that
  keeps your money, weapons, vehicles and characters. If you played an older version, move the `SGTA5...` files out
  of `Documents\Rockstar Games\GTA V\Profiles\<your profile>` once.
- If the game still stays on the loading screen, move the newest `SGTA5...` file (and its `.bak`) out of that folder
  and start again. Your Archipelago progress is not affected.

## Feedback and bug reports

Every report helps. You can reach me:

- on Discord: **Deesdee**
- with a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/dudleydehenau/GTAV-Archipelago/issues)

Please attach a bug report: in game, **F6 > Settings > Create a bug report**. It makes a zip with your save, the event
history, the settings and the logs of every mod, in `Archipelago\GameArchipelago\reports` next to `GTA5.exe`.

If the F6 menu does not open or the report is not created, send these files instead:

- `ScriptHookV.log` and `ScriptHookVDotNet.log`, next to `GTA5.exe`
- the `.log` files in the `Archipelago` folder and its subfolders (`GameArchipelago`, `GameEnvironment`,
  `MissionLauncher`, `GameTraps`, `GameCollectibles`)

Tell me what you were doing when it happened, it helps a lot.

## What is in this repository

| Folder | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`GameArchipelago`](GameArchipelago) | The Archipelago client (in-game menu on F6) and the APWorld (`apworld/gtav`). |
| [`GameEnvironment`](GameEnvironment) | Sterile open world: a new game without the story, locked characters, money, weapons, vehicles. |
| [`MissionLauncher`](MissionLauncher) | Starts any mission through the game's replay system: map markers, results, medals. |
| [`GameTraps`](GameTraps) | The traps. |
| [`GameCollectibles`](GameCollectibles) | The 247 collectibles and the free-roam feats. |
| [`GTAVArchipelagoSetup`](GTAVArchipelagoSetup) | The Windows installer. |

Each mod also works on its own and has its own README and changelog.

## Building

1. Open `GTAV-Archipelago.sln` in Visual Studio 2022 and build in **Release**. The build order is already set.
   `ScriptHookVDotNet3.dll` and `LemonUI.SHVDN3.dll` are in each `lib` folder.
2. Run `Make-Releases.ps1` in PowerShell. It writes one zip per mod, `gtav.apworld` and the setup zip into
   `releases`, with the layout the setup expects.
3. Publish all these files in one GitHub release. The setup always takes the newest release that contains each file.

The APWorld can be built on its own with `python GameArchipelago/tools/build_apworld.py`.

## Credits

- [ScriptHookV](http://www.dev-c.com/gtav/scripthookv/) by Alexander Blade.
- [ScriptHookVDotNet](https://github.com/scripthookvdotnet/scripthookvdotnet) and
  [LemonUI](https://github.com/LemonUIbyLemon/LemonUI), included in the `lib` folders under their own licenses.
- [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) and
  [Archipelago.MultiClient.Net](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago.MultiClient.Net).

Grand Theft Auto V is a trademark of Rockstar Games. This project is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

notes.text:
# GTA V Archipelago Setup 1.4.2

Download `GTAVArchipelagoSetup.exe`, run it and pick your GTA V folder: it installs ScriptHookVDotNet, LemonUI and every mod.
Put `gtav.apworld` in Archipelago to generate a game.

### 1.4.2
- When a download fails (error 504, timeouts), the setup fetches the same file through the GitHub API, which keeps
  working when the normal release links do not, then tries both again with a direct connection that skips the Windows
  proxy settings. The way that works is kept for the next files. If everything fails, the setup uses the same file
  from your Downloads folder when it is there, and installs everything else anyway.
- A "Download them in my browser" button opens the missing files in your browser. Once they are in Downloads, click
  "Install the mods" again. This also gets around an antivirus, a VPN or a proxy that blocks the setup but not the
  browser.
